sections.Profile:
"Richelieu," released by North Star Coin Machine Company in 1949, is a single-player, electro-mechanical pinball machine. The game was developed by brothers Gerard and Jacques Tremblay in Montreal, Canada.

- Manufacturer: North Star Coin Machine Company
- Years made: 1949
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Wood Rail, Racing, Horses, Original Theme
